hotel_name: Treebo Premium Eden Residency Near Sec 29

positive_snippets: A quite comfortable place close to mainstream of Gurgaon. Food is served hot and tasty. Good place worth the money.
negative_snippets:
While the rooms were good in size and comfort, there could be some more cleanliness and maintenance done. There were flickering lights, broken cloth holder/stand and dusty floors. Everything looked worn and could use with some update and maintenance.
WiFi was also not the fastest. BUT way better than staying in main Delhi, since this isnt too far away from the airport also.
Note there is no lift and there wasn't many consumable amenities like towels and brush etc.

Very bad Hotel staff was rude and unhelpful. Food was below average , and nothing they promised was delivered. Our room was not given on time, instead they asked for extra money. Not recommended at all.

My booking didn't taken even after app was showing booking confirmation.
Post reaching to hotel I was welcomed with cancellation
